note: A published cell label changing between releases is either a harmless
restyling or a change of meaning, and nothing in the data says which.
This file is where a human records the ones that have been reviewed and
found harmless. Anything not covered here blocks the comparison until it
is reviewed, rather than being disclosed and drawn anyway.

normalisation_rules.description: Leading, trailing or repeated whitespace only.
A trailing colon on a hierarchy heading.

A hyphen written as a space or vice versa, as in 'Foreign-born' and 'Foreign born'. Reviewed against the 2022 and 2023 ACS five-year releases of B05002, where the universe, the table position and the published estimate are unchanged.
A typographic dash or apostrophe written as its ASCII equivalent.
Dots in an abbreviation, as in 'U.S.' and 'US'.
